def main():
    N, M = map(int, input().split())
    S = [list(input()) for _ in range(N)]

    ans = M + 10

    for bit in range(1 << N):  # Iterate over all combinations of stalls

        store = []
        for i in range(N):  # Check each stall
            if bit >> i & 1:  # If the i-th bit is set, include this stall
                store.append(i)

        data = [0] * M
        for s_i in store:  # For each stall index in store
            for j, s_j in enumerate(S[s_i]):
                if s_j == 'o':  # If the popcorn type is available
                    data[j] = 1  # Mark the popcorn type as covered

        if data == [1] * M:  # Check if all popcorn types are covered
            ans = min(ans, len(store))  # Update the minimum number of stalls

    print(ans)
